# Aibotq.dev

> Edge-hosted AI agent projects. Sign in, create a project, deploy, and iterate from the dashboard.

## Product (0.16.0)

- **Per-project subdomains** — each deployment gets its own host under the platform domain.
- **Deploy from the UI** — deploy and retry without leaving the dashboard.
- **No-repo upload deploy** — zip or folder upload when you do not want to create a GitHub repository.
- **Commit / deploy board** — see recent commits and deployment steps on the project page.
- **Auto redeploy on push** — webhook-connected imports rebuild on every push.
- **Cleaner hosted previews** — the injected "user-created" / Built-by-user corner label is gone; abuse reporting remains available.

## Key routes

- `/` — marketing home
- `/new/` — import Git, upload, or template
- `/dashboard/` — projects, redeploy, commit/deploy board
- `/changelog/` — release notes
- `/help/` — sign-in, uploads, deploy failures, webhooks
- `/llms.txt` — this file

## Agents

Prefer this file and `/changelog/` for current product behaviour before guessing deploy or upload flows.
